Both changes are on the new branch `ui/react-flow-graph`, committed as `016abc2`. Typecheck, the 63 tests and the build pass, and I checked them in a browser against your real sessions in this repo.

## Graph
- **Renderer:** the map now uses `@xyflow/react` with a dagre layout instead of drawing mermaid through pele. The nodes follow the shadcn React Flow UI pattern, in `src/components/flow/base-node.tsx`:
  - **Steps and turns** are cards with a coloured kind icon and title, a badge for the tool name, agent type or turn id, a two-line label, and a footer showing duration, tool calls, tokens and event count.
  - **Sessions** are dark cards.
  - **Phases and subagent runs** are dashed frames with a label tab.
  - **Edges:** rewind edges are dashed pink with a "rewind" label, and subagent spawn edges are dashed violet.
  - **Extras:** a dotted background and a minimap you can pan and zoom.
- **Kept behaviour:** click to zoom in, hover cards, dimming, search-hit highlights, selection, follow mode, the zoom toolbar, keyboard shortcuts and the "moved towards the newest" signal all work as before.
- **Live updates:** these no longer reset the view. The graph only goes back to the readable view when you move to a different node.
- **Data model:** `analyzers/graph.ts` gains `focusFlow` and `projectFlow`, which build the same graph as plain data. The mermaid functions are untouched because the engine still writes `graph.mmd`.

## Rendered raw views
`src/Json.tsx` adds a `JsonView` used everywhere the Raw level used to show plain JSON: tool results, structured tool-call fields and other records.
- **Layout:** objects become labelled rows, lists of similar records become tables, short lists become chips, and long strings become text with their code blocks highlighted. JSON stored inside strings, which MCP results often contain, is unpacked.
- **Nothing hidden:** every branch can be folded but starts open (up to four levels deep), and a **JSON** toggle on each block shows the original source.

## Things to know
- **Tall sessions:** "show the whole graph" stops at 20% zoom, so a 36-turn session still doesn't fit on screen. That limit was the same before.
- **Bundle size:** the UI bundle is now over Vite's 500 kB warning. Splitting it is an easy follow-up if it matters.
- **Removed dependency:** `pele` is no longer a UI dependency. The pitch deck and the pele-markdown package still use it.
- **Not merged or pushed:** your uncommitted `.yolo-twice/` session files were left out of the commit.
